subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word segment in the following sentence.

It is a __high-pay__ job.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"high-pay"** is not commonly used in English to describe a job with a high salary. (उच्च वेतन)

 
 
• **Example: **Incorrect: It is a high-pay job.
 
 
 
• **"High-paying"** is the correct term to describe a job that offers a high salary. (उच्च वेतन वाली)
 
 
• **Example: **She has a high-paying job at a multinational company.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. 'high-paying'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Low-paid** (कम वेतन वाली): Describes a job that offers a low salary.

 
 
• **Example:** He is struggling with his low-paid job.
 
 
 
• **Low-pay** (कम वेतन): Not a commonly used term in English.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: It is a low-pay job.
 
 
 
• **High-paid** (उच्च वेतन वाली): Grammatically incorrect when describing a job.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: It is a high-paid job.
